questions.q: What shape are the little rooms in a honeycomb?
questions.fact: Hexagons! Six-sided cells fit together with no gaps, so bees get the most storage space while using the least wax.

choices: Bees make it from glands on their bellies
Bees scrape it off tree bark
questions.fact: From their bellies! Young worker bees have special wax glands under their abdomens that make tiny flakes of wax, which they chew and shape into comb.

questions.q: Besides honey, what else do bees keep in honeycomb cells?
questions.fact: Baby bees and pollen! The queen lays eggs in the cells, and bees also pack pollen there as food for the growing babies.

questions.q: Which of these do people make with beeswax?
questions.fact: Candles! Beeswax is also used in lip balm, crayons, and wood polish, and beeswax candles smell a little like honey.
